text:
Alex Reynolds: Following up on the KV-cache postmortem — we have 4 concrete remediation items (1) eviction backoff + QoS, (2) alert thresholds + dedupe, (3) oncall runbook + rotation handoff, (4) scheduled KV warmup before nightly batch. Need owners and Jira tickets.
Maya Li: I can own (1) eviction backoff. Will sketch a safe backoff algorithm and config guardrails. I will open a Jira and tag eng-runtime + infra. ETA: EOD Wednesday. :+1:
Rohan Kapoor: I'll take (2) alert thresholds and dedupe. We should avoid pager storms; propose a two-tier alert (warning + critical) that hits oncall only at critical. I'll also add metric cardinality checks.
Priya Nair: I'll pick up (3) the runbook and rotation update. I'll add a section in /runbooks/kv-eviction.md and link sample playbook snippets. Can someone paste the troubleshooting commands we used?
Alex Reynolds: Commands we used in the incident: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=30m | grep kv` and `redis-cli -h kv-cache-1 INFO` and `rundump --since 3h > /tmp/kv-dump.log`. Put those into Jira descriptions and the runbook.
Maya Li: Jira REM-3051 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-3051 "kv eviction backoff + qos" assigned to Maya. Due 2025-07-09.
Rohan Kapoor: REM-3052 created for alerting: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-3052. Set priority P2 and linked relevant graphs. I'll prototype alert rules and a dedupe layer.
Priya Nair: I'll create REM-3053 for runbook/runbook rotation and link both tickets. Will add a one-page runbook excerpt and a short checklist for oncall handover.
Rohan Kapoor: Noting a recurring pattern — spikes align with the nightly batch job every ~21 days when sequence lengths increase. Suggest REM-3054 for scheduled KV warmup pre-batch. I can help define the warmup probe.
Alex Reynolds: Good. Can we follow a RACI matrix for these four items? Tentative: R: Maya (1), Rohan (2), Priya (3), Rohan+Maya (4); A: Alex; C: eng-runtime, eng-ml; I: oncall rota, SRE. Please update tickets with RACI blocks.
Maya Li: I'll add a RACI table to REM-3051. Also I'll include a short canary plan: patch canary to 5% of traffic for 2 hours, observe kv miss rate and p95 latency.
Priya Nair: Runbook path: `/runbooks/kv-eviction.md` — I'll add the play steps, the pager flow, and the exact `kubectl` and `rundump` commands. I'll also add a 'how to run warmup' snippet.
OpsBot: Reminder: I'll post weekly reminders for unclosed REM tickets and ping #eng-oncall on high-priority regressions.
Rohan Kapoor: I've noted a config delta on 2025-05-30 where default kernel selection changed for Llama-variant models; logged that in REM-3052 and linked to the model-onboarding changelog. Maya, can you check if the backoff interacts with the new kernel heuristics?
Maya Li: Will check. If there's coupling, we may need a guardrail flag to disable the kernel heuristic under heavy KV pressure. I'll record findings in REM-3051 by Friday.
Priya Nair: I'll prototype a minimal warmup script and add smoke checks to CI that run pre-batch; will attach to REM-3054. ETA Tue next week.
Alex Reynolds: Timeline summary: owners assigned, tickets REM-3051/3052/3053/3054 opened, canary target 2025-07-15 window. If owners cannot meet ETA, escalate to me. Also add acceptance criteria to each ticket (metrics and no new p95 regressions for 24h).
Rohan Kapoor: ack
Maya Li: ack
Priya Nair: ack
Alex Reynolds: Thanks. I'll update the postmortem doc with ticket links and the RACI table, then we can close the loop at the remediation sync on Friday.
